description: This file defines a utility enum `CaptureRateLimits` containing static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (fps) within specified ranges.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps an optional millisecond duration value within the specified min and max bounds, returning a default if nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps an optional fps value within the specified min and max bounds, returns default if not finite.
